product.title: Koloa Zipline in Kauai

description.text: Get a new perspective on Kauai as you soar through lush forests and over the Waita Reservoir on the island's longest ziplines. While cruising across the 8-track course near Koloa, hang on to the handlebars or try some more daring acrobatic stunts with the hands-free 'Flyin' Kauai'an' harness. Stops include Koloa Zipline, Waita Reservoir, Koloa Sugar Mill. Transportation, equipment, and local commentary are handled so you can focus on Kauai's canyons, coastlines, waterfalls, and cultural landmarks. Ideal for visitors basing on Kauai who want a guided island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
